div.head: Af 25
div.ab: XXVI. Gif ciorles mennen to nydhæmede mon geþreatað, mid V scll' gebete ðam ciorle and LX scll' to wite.
XXIII. Gif mon ceorles mennen to nedhæmde geðreatað, mid V scill. gebete þam ceorle; ⁊ LX scill. to wite.
Si homo (quis) ceorles mancipium ad uiolentum concubitum comminetur, emendet ipsi ceorlo (id est rustico) quinque sol.; et LX sol. wite.
{XXIII} Gif mones ceorles mennen to nedhæmde geðreatað, mid V scill gebete þam ceorle; ⁊ LX schill to wite.
If someone rapes a ceorl’s slave, let him recompense the ceorl with 5 shillings, and 60 shillings as fine.
If anyone rapes the slave of a commoner, he shall pay 5 shillings to the commoner, and a fine of 60 shillings.
Wenn jemand eines Gemeinfreien Sklavin zur Nothzucht zwingt, büsse er dem Gemeinfreien mit 5 Schill.; und 60 Schill. zum Strafgeld [dem König].
If someone forces a common freeman’s slave woman to intercourse, let him pay the common freeman 5 shillings; and 60 shillings as a fine [to the king].
div.note: In H this clause stands after Af 31.1, numbered XXVI.
